summary: Someone else’s urgency can easily turn a routine disagreement into a contest over who holds the final say.
body: Someone else’s urgency can easily turn a routine disagreement into a contest over who holds the final say. When the Sun opposes Mars, your core direction comes up against another person's push to compete, confront, or move faster, which makes both sides dig in harder than the situation requires. If a conversation shifts from solving a problem to defending authority, steer it back to the actual decision on the table. You do not have to match someone else's escalation to maintain your own leverage. Address the logistical issue in front of you and leave them to manage their own adrenaline.
